client-without-client-id.json.rule: a client or account-manager card names its client (F-46)

grant-missing-with-buttons.json.rule: a missing-grant card has no buttons (F-47)

grant-missing-without-link.json.rule: a missing-grant card carries its re-grant link (F-47)

manual-url-file-input.json.rule: an input is a url or a text (F-47)

manual-url-without-inputs.json.rule: a manual-URL card asks for its input (F-47)

review-default-approve.json.rule: a review card defaults to reject (qualifier §5.2 L61)

review-unknown-action.json.rule: a button is one of the review actions (qualifier §5.3 L67)

review-without-buttons.json.rule: a review card carries its buttons (qualifier §5.3 L67)

review-without-timeout.json.rule: a review card times out after 24 hours (qualifier §5.2 L61)

subject-without-ref.json.rule: a card's subject names its decision or request (F-47)

webhook-channel.json.rule: a card goes through n8n's channels only (ADR-0067)

with-provenance.json.rule: an n8n notice carries producer only (F-51)
